mapper.sql: d.deposit_id, d.out_trade_no, d.recharge_id, d.member_id, m.phone, d.asset, d.network, d.currency, d.amount, d.pay_amount, d.address, d.address_source, d.collect_member_id, cm.phone as collect_phone, cm.invite_code as collect_invite_code, d.status, d.tx_hash, d.from_address, d.expire_time, d.paid_time, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.remark

deposit_id, out_trade_no, recharge_id, member_id, asset, network, currency, amount, pay_amount, address, address_source, collect_member_id, status, tx_hash, from_address, expire_time, paid_time, create_time, update_time, remark
mapper.select: select from biz_chain_deposit d left join biz_member m on m.member_id = d.member_id left join biz_member cm on cm.member_id = d.collect_member_id where d.deposit_id = #{depositId}
select from biz_chain_deposit d left join biz_member m on m.member_id = d.member_id left join biz_member cm on cm.member_id = d.collect_member_id where d.out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}
select from biz_chain_deposit where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} for update

select from biz_chain_deposit where status = '0' and pay_amount = #{payAmount} and ifnull(nullif(network,''),'TRC20') = #{network} and lower(address) = lower(#{address}) and expire_time > sysdate() order by deposit_id asc limit 1 for update
select from biz_chain_deposit d left join biz_member m on m.member_id = d.member_id left join biz_member cm on cm.member_id = d.collect_member_id where d.tx_hash = #{txHash}
select min(create_time) from biz_chain_deposit where status = '0' and expire_time > sysdate()
select min(create_time) from biz_chain_deposit where status = '0' and expire_time > sysdate() and ifnull(nullif(network,''),'TRC20') = #{network} and lower(address) = lower(#{address})
select distinct ifnull(nullif(network,''),'TRC20') as network, address from biz_chain_deposit where status = '0' and expire_time > sysdate()

select from biz_chain_deposit d left join biz_member m on m.member_id = d.member_id left join biz_member cm on cm.member_id = d.collect_member_id where d.status = '0' and d.expire_time > sysdate() order by d.deposit_id asc
select from biz_chain_deposit where status = '0' and expire_time <= sysdate()
